data.name: TAD: That Alien Dude
data.detailed_description:
TAD: That Alien Dude®

PERMADEATH EDITION


Gameplay

You control TAD: That Alien Dude on his quest to escape the infamous Area 91, where he and his cartoon pals of yesteryear have been "protected" by the US Government since the early 1990s. Control TAD in a 2D open world with your keyboard or joypad, fighting off enemies with Pigman's Blade of Avalon, the only known weapon in the Toon Alley sector of Area 91.

With your blade, move through a postmodern map reminiscent of RPGs from "back in the day," where you'll encounter pixel perfect scientists, transhumanists, reptoids, and more as you escape a nightmare of quests, trying to take down whatever nefarious forces are truly controlling Area 91 so that you may return to Hollywoodland, and reintegrate yourself into the animation landscape of today.

With 5 Dungeons and bosses, multiple quests, and a whole lot of original pixel art with an original synthwave OST, do you have what it takes to get the highest score?


Features

* Multilevel map of Area 91, the infamous government military installation that holds living simulations, nuclear reactors, and more madness than a government regime should have access to.
* RPG mechanics: As you go on quests for your fellow captives, er, neighbors, discover the hidden secrets of Area 91 and level up your player and the Blade of Avalon's power.
* Hand drawn pixel art and original soundtrack: All pixel art and music composed especially for this release
* 5 Dungeons: Each dungeon has it's own boss, bosses move along paths based on the application of Catastrophe Theory (Oooh! Real science! KEEN!)
* Longform Animated Cutscenes: A storyline so wild and exciting, you might forget you aren't watching a Saturday Morning Cartoon show!

reviews.review:
[b] A TAD Broken [/b]
If you know me, you knwo I like weird stuff, weird games. ( feel free to see the games i end up finding ) 
I'll be adding TAD to this list of oddities, and the real shame here is this game doesn't appear to be a finished product.

The first warning sign was the exe's were all named ( Alpha ) 
I figured this was just an oversight, and the exes names werent changed.

Well.

PLaying the game - You are tossed into a town, no actual story or even a tite screen, really.
You can swing a sword, and move around ( issues with my controller, the Dpad's up and down were reversed, and left and right didn't work , the analogue was.. not accurate in the slightest. Very loose. ) 

There's blocks you can't remove at exits to the " town " and the " houses" also have them, with NPCs inside.
ONe house has an opening, the character says to go to the south.

You go south, and get a guy that is into vape, I suppose. And he says a bunch of dialogue which ends up in fight with the guy a a boss.

He slams into me, and im instantly dead literally seconds after I loaded. 
He does 25 damage per attack, and TAD inly has 50 HP.
You can imagine this leads to a very difficult Stage 1 Boss. ( there are no items to use, there are no menus, there ar eno other ways to go, nobody to talk to - you MUST fight this boss to advance ) 

This took me abotu 20 attempts, I like to think I'm decently skilled at video games, not one of my deaths felt fair.
I eventually found a way to tuck into a corner, and damage him without being touched - which took a lot of time and patience.

As soon as he dies ( finally, I actually did it  !^^ ) I get more story, and then I'm back in town, on Level " 2 " 

There's a new house with an opening in it, so I go in - the NPC says something about going East , SO i walk to the right - and the town exit is blocked off.
I go to the left, and it's open.

Then I am greeted with another dialogue dump from a scientist, and then thrust into a room full of multiple verisons of him.
I defeat as many As I can find, wandering around a bit as well. Itsuddnely warps me into a diffferent room, with the NPC's I've talked to so far. They say what they need to say ( which seemed terribly out of context ) and i find there are no exits. I am also able to walk right through the southern walls and slightly on the bottoms of the left and right walls. Right out of bounds, into blackness - I originally thought this was intenitonal - But I found nothing int he Black Void. So i wandered back to the room, and hit a wall part of an exit - which gave me the same scientist guy dialogue from before. Only this time, I was warped to a totally different room with a gigantic scientist guy, and only 1/4 of the screen in the game's frame that I could see, but no walls o anything - so the scientist guy floats off into part of the world I can't see, but can go to myself. 


I'm gonna have to give this game a hard pass.
